contentNote: SRD 5.2.1 class foundations have been reorganized into edition-specific structured data. Full class-feature and subclass rules will be stored in separate later collections.

entries.title: Barbarian
entries.summary: A durable Strength-based warrior who channels Rage, fights without heavy armor, and excels with martial weapons.
entries.description: This 2024 class-foundation entry gathers the class’s core traits, starting and multiclass proficiencies, SRD subclass, and feature progression without mixing mechanics from the other edition.

facts.label: Skill Proficiencies
facts.value: Choose 2: Animal Handling, Athletics, Intimidation, Nature, Perception, or Survival

facts.label: Armor Training / Proficiencies
facts.value: Light and Medium armor and Shields

facts.label: Starting Equipment
facts.value: Choose A: Greataxe, 4 Handaxes, Explorer’s Pack, and 15 GP; or B: 75 GP

facts.label: Proficiencies Gained by Multiclassing
facts.value: Hit Point Die, Martial weapons, and Shields

traits.name: Starting as This Class
traits.description: At character level 1, gain the class’s complete starting traits and its level 1 features. Starting Hit Points use the maximum value of the Hit Point Die plus your Constitution modifier.

traits.name: Multiclassing into This Class
traits.description: You must meet the listed ability-score prerequisite. You gain only the reduced multiclass proficiencies listed above, plus the class’s level 1 features. You do not gain a second set of full starting equipment.

traits.name: Progression Table Scope
traits.description: The progression below records the class-feature names and Proficiency Bonus at each class level. Individual feature rules, resource columns, spell-slot columns, and subclass feature text belong to the next Codex collections.
